summary: community.general 13.0.0-era deprecations: catapult, cpanm mode=compatibility, dimensiondata modules and fragments, github_repo force_defaults=true, hiera lookup and oci_utils, all removed in 13.0.0.
questions: Is the hiera lookup being removed?

answer_card.title: community.general deprecations (13.0.0, part 1)
answer_card.answer_md:
Removed in community.general 13.0.0 unless noted:

- `catapult`
- `cpanm`: `mode=compatibility` deprecated; use `mode=new`
- `dimensiondata` doc fragments and module utils, `dimensiondata_network`, `dimensiondata_vlan`, `dimensiondata_wait` fragments
- `github_repo`: `force_defaults=true` deprecated
- `hiera` lookup
- `oci_utils` module utils
